statement: HubSpot documentation says exporting CRM records requires export permissions and can include current record properties and associations.
caveat: Activities and subscription-specific export limits require separate account-level verification.

statement: Pipedrive documents spreadsheet imports using XLS, XLSX and CSV files and notes that appropriate import permissions are required.
caveat: Confirm account permissions, supported record types, mandatory fields and current upload limits.

statement: Ahrefs documentation says internal HTML pages returning HTTP 200 consume Site Audit crawl credits, while certain redirects and assets do not.
caveat: Credit allowances and verified-site entitlements depend on plan and may change over time.

statement: Semrush documentation describes configurable Site Audit page limits and options for restricting crawl scope to subdomains or subfolders.
caveat: Per-audit and monthly allowances depend on the current subscription plan and must be checked.

statement: Kinsta states that WordPress hosting plans include usage allowances and exceeding some limits can result in overage charges.
caveat: Confirm the current WordPress plan, measurement rules, notifications, taxes and overage rates.

statement: Cloudways documentation describes separately billed off-site backups for Flexible hosting and backups included for Autonomous hosting.
caveat: The distinction applies to specific hosting families; independently verify charges and retention.
